title: Keyo Mar Pinyni
stanzas: Keyo mar pinyni to koro chiegini; Ruoth dwaro jokeyo ni mondo gibi, Kendo gika chambe e puothe duto,Mond` okan e deche ka Ruodhwa biro.
Ndalono mochwere, ma pi wang` onge,Okayo machiegni, ochiegni koro;To yamo mar richo dwaro keyo cham,Returu ukawe, pod kinde nitie.
Kwatiyo gi hera to en tich mamit;Konyruok anwa malo, konyruok mosiko;Ruodh hera moluongwa, wadhi wamak tich;Cham ritowa koro to keyono duong`.
chorus: Ndalono.... chiegni, Kauru...... chamber (Un jokeyo ret uru, ret uru, Kauru cham mar Ruodhwa, mar Ruodhwa;) Ndalono.....chiegni, Ruoth biro (Un jokeyo returu, returu, Ruoth chiegni biro.)
